differences: The paper discusses the use of graph summarization techniques to address computational challenges in handling large-scale graphs.
Specifically, it mentions the application of graph neural networks (GNNs) for graph summarization, which can lead to accelerated training and reduced computational resource consumption.
evidence_cards.document_title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Summarization with Graph Neural Networks
evidence_cards.main_contribution: Utilized graph summarization techniques to accelerate model training and reduce computational resource consumption.

sources.quote: As large-scale graphs become more widespread, more and more computational challenges with extracting, processing, and interpreting large graph data are being exposed. It is therefore natural to search for ways to summarize these expansive graphs while preserving their key characteristics.
sources.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Summarization with Graph Neural Networks

sources.quote: Hence, this paper presents a comprehensive survey of progress in deep learning summarization techniques that rely on graph neural networks (GNNs).
